Atrial extrasystole (altered P, narrow QRS, incomplete compensatory pause)
Ventricular extrasystole (no P, wide QRS, inverted T, complete compensatory pause)
First-degree AV block: PQ 0.32 s, every P is followed by a QRS
Second-degree AV block, Mobitz I (Wenckebach periods): PQ lengthens progressively until a QRS is dropped
Second-degree AV block, Mobitz II: PQ constant, some P waves are not followed by a QRS
Third-degree (complete) AV block: P and QRS are independent, idioventricular rhythm 30 beats/min
Atrial fibrillation: no P, f waves, irregular RR intervals
